name: Fill
description: Fill/: the suite's one gradient model. Fill, GradientStop and FillColor as FlareCore's Fill, GradientStop and Color under kernel names, FillType (solid, linear, radial), FillSelection (a fill and its box) and the GradientFillTarget protocol an app's workspace conforms to; GradientRules (the stop, angle and box rules: maxStops, stopHelp, converted, angle, rotated, color, adding, moving, removing and recolouring stops, mapped); GradientIntent (the gradient editor's gestures as commands) and GradientCommands (the eight fill.* command specs every app registers); GradientSVG (a fill as an SVG gradient definition); GradientBar (the gradient editor's stop bar as numbers: offsets inset half a handle each side, and the colour row's selected-stop label). gradient-fill GF-1 declares them as stubs (specs with real ids, schemas and availability); GF-5, GF-6 and GF-7 fill the bodies.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
